purpose: Extract reusable parity metrics and signals from TORCH-BRIDGE-001 and TORCH-CLI-003 artifacts

reusable_signals.shape_validation: target_shape and bragg_shape arrays confirm tensor dimensions [panel, slow, fast]
reusable_signals.masked_mse: baseline metric for comparing model vs target; useful for parity runs but not directly comparable to correlation (different semantic)
reusable_signals.mask_coverage: loss_mask_coverage indicates fraction of pixels included in MSE; critical for ROI-based parity
reusable_signals.intensity_stats: mean/max intensity per panel useful for sanity checks but not primary parity metric
reusable_signals.roi_count: n_rois provides context for test scale; parity tests may use single panel or multiple panels

limitations.stub_simulator: Metrics generated with stub Gaussian simulator, not real nanobrag_torch output
limitations.no_correlation: Missing image correlation metric (required by DB-AT-001 spec ≥0.99)
limitations.no_trace: No per-pixel trace captured (required by spec-db-tracing.md workflow)
limitations.no_golden_comparison: No golden reference data; metrics are smoke test only

reusable_signals.test_execution_metadata: runtime_s, hardware, python_version useful for all test reports
reusable_signals.pass_fail_summary: total_tests, tests_passed, tests_failed standard test report structure
reusable_signals.implementation_status: Structured status tracking (implemented/complete/functional) useful for phased rollout documentation

limitations.cli_focused: Diagnostics focused on CLI dispatch, not physics parity
limitations.no_physics_metrics: No correlation, MSE, RMSE, or other physics comparison metrics
limitations.no_golden_data: No golden reference or diff heatmap artifacts

metrics_schema_proposal.description: Proposed standardized metrics.json schema for DB-AT parity runs, synthesizing TORCH-* artifacts and testing_strategy.md §2.5 requirements

required_fields.threshold_met: Boolean indicating if correlation ≥ spec threshold (bool)
required_fields.spec_threshold: Threshold from spec (float, e.g., 0.99 for DB-AT-001)

optional_fields.ssim: Structural similarity index (float, [0,1], optional for visual validation)
optional_fields.mean_intensity_golden: Mean pixel intensity in golden data (float)
optional_fields.mean_intensity_py: Mean pixel intensity in PyTorch output (float)
optional_fields.n_panels: Number of detector panels (int, from target_shape[0])
optional_fields.target_shape: Shape of input/target tensors (array of int)

trace_schema_proposal.description: Proposed trace log structure per spec-db-tracing.md:15-26 and testing_strategy.md §2.5.1
required_trace_fields: pix0_vector (detector pixel origin in lab frame)
F_latt_a, F_latt_b, F_latt_c (lattice factors per axis)
trace_schema_proposal.format_notes: Use consistent units (meters, steradians, Ångströms) and float64 precision for determinism

artifact_directory_proposal.description: Proposed parity-specific subdirectory structure extending plans/active/<initiative>/reports/<timestamp>/ pattern

structure.parity/golden_trace_panel{p}_s{s}_f{f}.l: Golden reference trace for selected pixel
structure.parity/diff_heatmap_panel{p}.png: Visual diff heatmap (golden - py) per panel
structure.parity/summary.md: Human-readable summary with metrics, threshold status, first divergence notes

environment_flags_summary.description: Consolidated environment flag requirements from TESTING_GUIDE.md §1 and testing_strategy.md §1.6

determinism_tests_DB_AT_002.TORCHDYNAMO_DISABLE: 1 (prevent TorchDynamo device query crash with empty CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES)

canonical_commands_summary.DB_AT_002_determinism: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' TORCHDYNAMO_DISABLE=1 NANOBRAGG_DISABLE_COMPILE=1 KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK=TRUE pytest -v tests -k DB_AT_002

gaps_requiring_new_tooling.correlation_computation: None of the reviewed artifacts compute image correlation; need helper function (e.g., np.corrcoef or scipy.stats.pearsonr wrapper)
gaps_requiring_new_tooling.trace_capture: No trace capture helpers exist in DBEX; need integration with spec-db-tracing.md workflow (likely via nanobrag_torch debug_config)
gaps_requiring_new_tooling.diff_heatmap_generation: No visualization artifacts beyond roi_triptych.png; need matplotlib-based diff heatmap helper
gaps_requiring_new_tooling.golden_data_loader: No fixture for loading golden reference data from nanoBragg2/tests/golden_data or DBEX-local mirror
gaps_requiring_new_tooling.metrics_json_writer: No standardized helper to write metrics.json per proposed schema; need utility function

recommendations_for_phase_b.1_adopt_metrics_schema: Use proposed metrics.json schema as normative template for all parity runs; update docs/spec-db-tracing.md or create docs/parity_harness_spec.md
recommendations_for_phase_b.2_implement_correlation_helper: Author tests/fixtures/parity_helpers.py with compute_correlation(golden, py) -> float function
recommendations_for_phase_b.3_integrate_trace_workflow: Define minimal trace capture fixture using nanobrag_torch debug_config; document in harness spec
recommendations_for_phase_b.4_standardize_artifact_layout: Mandate parity/ subdirectory for all DB-AT test runs; update TESTING_GUIDE.md §3
recommendations_for_phase_b.5_create_golden_fixture: Author conftest.py fixture to locate and load golden data (nanoBragg2 path or DBEX mirror)
recommendations_for_phase_b.6_document_environment_matrix: Create environment flags crosswalk table in harness spec linking test profiles to required flags
